ai_debug_dyninteractions.help: Debug the NPC dynamic interaction system.

ai_debug_expressions.help: Show random expression decisions for NPCs.

bb_gamemodedata_team_rounds_swap.help: Amount of rounds between team swaps (0 disables swapping)

bb_global_kbscale.help: Scales knockback globally for gameplay testing.

bb_grab_break_bonus.help: When breaking a grab, the bonus gained by the defender.

bb_grab_dot.help: Min dot for grabbing an opponent.

bb_hitstop_time.help: Amount of time hitstop pauses for (multiplied a bit based on tier etc)

bb_intercept_momentum_scale.help: Multiplier for attacker\'s momentum during intercept.

bb_intercept_time.help: Lock time when successfully doing a Jian intercept.

bb_intercept_warmup.help: How much time there needs to be before intercept defense activates.

bb_jump_punch.help: Amount of velocity to impart when wasd is used while jumping.

bb_jumpgravity_scale_start.help: start amount of jump gravity scale

bb_kb_air_parry.help: Force to knockback in air parries.

bb_kb_air_parry_up.help: How much up vector to knockback in air parries.

bb_kb_block.help: Multiplier for kb during regular block.

bb_kb_parry_keep_momentum.help: Whether or not parries should maintain player momentum when calculating knockback.

bb_kb_post_interrupt_jump_scale.help: How much to scale velocity by during hitstun and jump.

bb_knockbackfromdamage.help: Scale of damage translated into force.\n

bb_passive_mode.help: 0 = No-one is passive, 1 = Everyone is fully passive, 2 = Only players not in duels are passive, 3 = Only players sitting down are passive.

bb_player_softcollision_enable.help: Toggles soft collisions on and off.

bb_prevent_player_attacks.help: If turned on, players won\'t be able to attack.

bb_recovery_air.help: Recovery time for getting hit in mid-air.

bb_recovery_hit_world.help: Recovery time hitting world. Stop hurting the environment!

bb_recovery_intercept.help: Recovery time for getting hit by jian intercept.

bb_roll_air.help: Enable roll while in the air

bb_roll_delay.help: Enforce a delay between roll input

bb_roll_delay_on_attack.help: Makes attacking use up combat move cooldown.

bb_rollcancel_time.help: Minimum time between pressing roll/dash and canceling out of it.

bb_sheathed_runspeed_multiplier.help: Running while sheathed in CP game mode is scaled by this much.

bb_shuffle_delay.help: Enforce a delay between shuffle input

bb_shufflecancel_time.help: Minimum time between pressing shuffle and canceling out of it.

bb_side_cancel_percent_fast.help: Amount of an attack that can be canceled when using the opposite direction side attack.

bb_side_cancel_percent_heavy.help: Amount of an attack that can be canceled when using the opposite direction side attack.

bb_stats_output.help: When sending stats events to the server, logs the event to the console.

bb_stats_output_file.help: When sending stats events to the server, logs the event to LastStatsEvent.json.

bb_string_reset.help: Whether or not the victim\'s string resets on hit.

bb_string_reset_time.help: Maximum delay between swings to remain in-combo

bb_string_sideattack_advance.help: Do side attacks advance string counter?

bb_throwable_angular_speed_homing.help: Used to smooth trajectory path while targeting.

bb_throwable_autoblock_dot_min.help: Min dot required for players to auto block a throwable weapon.

bb_throwable_block_or_parry_dot_min.help: Min dot required for manual block via parry or block action.

bb_throwable_cancelable.help: Allows throwable weapons to be canceled if button not held.

bb_throwable_damage_player.help: Damage dealt to players that have not been blocked.

bb_throwable_delay.help: Time it takes until you can throw a weapon again.

bb_throwable_gravity.help: Amount of gravity to apply after a certain distance if not targeting.

bb_throwable_interrupt_on_hit.help: Whether or not throwable weapon causes interrupt on hit.

bb_throwable_life_duration.help: Time to keep alive after impact.

bb_throwable_phys_force.help: Force to apply to phys objects.

bb_throwable_random_amount.help: Randomizes destination position if not targeting.

bb_throwable_spawn_delay.help: How long after throw star action has started should star be created.

bb_throwable_target_distance_max.help: Max distance for targeting to work.

bb_throwable_target_dot_min_right.help: Used to determine which players can be targeted.

bb_throwable_target_dot_min_up.help: Used to determine which players can be targeted.

bb_tracer_default_grip_offset.help: Distance from sword_grip bone to inner tracer point.

bb_tracer_default_length.help: How far down the sword grip does the tracer go.

bb_tracer_fade_speed.help: Fade speed used after tracer script finished.

bb_tracer_max_hit_tests.help: # of points to be used for damage traces, begin at tail.

bb_tracer_parry_bloat_fwd.help: Extends tracer parry obb along fwd.

bb_tracer_parry_bloat_side.help: Extends tracer parry obb along its sides.

bb_tracer_parry_damage_multiplier.help: Damage multiplier for player who lost a tracer vs tracer resolution.

bb_turnanimation_attack_angle.help: Degrees to turn when taking damage and being struck by left/right.

bb_turnanimation_parry_angle.help: Degrees to turn when tracer parried.

bb_vote_kick_required_percentage.help: Minimum amount of positive votes required

bb_vote_required_percentage.help: Minimum amount of positive votes required

bb_wallclimb_flip_dot_max.help: Minmimum dot product to automatically trigger flipping off the wall.

bb_wallclimb_min_dot.help: Minmimum dot product to allow climbing on.

bb_wallclimb_min_height.help: Minmimum height to trigger wall climbing.

bot_actiondir.help: Sets the direction the bot actions. -1 = Do nothing, 0 = forwards, 1 = left, 2 = right

bot_announce_parry.help: Bot will announce to players when to parry him. 1 for tier 1, 2 for tier 2, 3 for tier 3.

bot_arcade.help: Set whether the bot will default to arcade mode or not.

bot_attack_random_directions.help: Makes the bot pick a new random direction every time he attacks.

bot_attack_random_tiers.help: Makes the bot pick a random tier every time he attacks.

bot_attack_wait.help: Bot will wait this long between attacks.

bot_avoidance.help: Enable player avoidance for bots. Requires bb_player_softcollision.

bot_block.help: Forces the bot to be blocking.

bot_changeclass.help: Force all bots to change to the specified class.

bot_defend.help: Bot will block and parry when attacked.

bot_face_nearest.help: Forces bots to always face the nearest player.

bot_flipout.help: When on, all bots fire their guns.

bot_force_stance.help: Forces the bot use a stance regardless of mimic.

bot_forceattackon.help: When firing, don\'t tap fire, hold it down.

bot_forcefireweapon.help: Force bots with the specified weapon to fire.

bot_forwardmove.help: Positive values to make bot walk forward, negative to go backwards.

bot_maintain_distance.help: Sets a distance for the bot to maintain away from his opponent. Used in conjunction with bot_face_nearest 1

bot_maintain_jump.help: Forces the bot to jump when player is above it.\n

bot_mimic.help: Bot uses usercmd of player by index.

bot_parry_last_attack.help: Bot will only parry the last attempted direction from player.

bot_random_actions.help: Have the bots do random actions.

bot_sendcmd.help: Forces bots to send the specified command.

bot_sidemove.help: Positive values to make bot strafe right, negative strafe left.

bot_stance.help: Forces the bot use a particular stance. Balanced, Reverse, Heavy in that order.

bot_tier_attack.help: Charge attacks to the specified tier, then... Slash!

bot_use_convar_actions.help: Execute the bot ai that only follows the convar actions.

cc_norepeat.help: In multiplayer games, don\'t repeat captions more often than this many seconds.

choreo_spew_filter.help: Spew choreo. Use a sub-string or * to display all events.

cl_use_simd_bones.help: 1 use SIMD bones 0 use scalar bones.

commentary_available.help: Automatically set by the game when a commentary file is available for the current map.

ent_show_contexts.help: Show entity contexts in ent_text display

fish_dormant.help: Turns off interactive fish behavior. Fish become immobile and unresponsive.

fog_volume_debug.help: If enabled, prints diagnostic information about the current fog volume

g_ai_threadedgraphbuild.help: If true, use experimental threaded node graph building.

g_debug_constraint_sounds.help: Enable debug printing about constraint sounds.

g_debug_transitions.help: Set to 1 and restart the map to be warned if the map has no trigger_transition volumes. Set to 2 to see a dump of all entities & associated results during a transition.

gamestats_file_output_directory.help: When -gamestatsfileoutputonly is specified, file will be emitted here instead of to modpath\n

global_chatter_info.help: Map/mode-specific responserules criteria used by calls to UTIL_GlobalChatter

global_event_log_enabled.help: Enables the global event log system

mapcycledisabled.help: repeats the same map after each match instead of using the map cycle

mapcyclefile.help: Name of the .txt file used to cycle the maps on multiplayer servers

mod_load_preload.help: Indicates how far ahead in seconds to preload animations.

mp_allowspectators.help: toggles whether the server allows spectator mode or not

mp_buy_during_immunity.help: When set, players can buy when immune, ignoring buytime. 0 = default. 1 = both teams. 2 = Terrorists. 3 = Counter-Terrorists.

mp_clan_ready_signal.help: Text that team leader from each team must speak for the match to begin

mp_clan_readyrestart.help: If non-zero, game will restart once someone from each team gives the ready signal

mp_facefronttime.help: After this amount of time of standing in place but aiming to one side, go ahead and move feet to face upper body.

mp_feetyawrate.help: How many degrees per second that we can turn our feet or upper body.

mp_fraglimit.help: The number of kills at which the map ends

mp_friendlyfire.help: Allows team members to injure other members of their team

mp_match_restart_delay.help: Time (in seconds) until a match restarts.

mp_radar_showall.help: Determines who should see all. 0 = default. 1 = both teams. 2 = Terrorists. 3 = Counter-Terrorists.

mp_restartgame.help: If non-zero, game will restart in the specified number of seconds

mp_suicide_time.help: Specifies number of seconds required to wait before another suicide.

mp_teammates_are_enemies.help: When set, your teammates act as enemies and all players are valid targets.

mp_timelimit.help: game time per map in minutes

mp_timelimit_free.help: game time per map in minutes on non-duel maps

mp_waitingforplayers_cancel.help: Set to 1 to end the WaitingForPlayers period.

mp_waitingforplayers_restart.help: Set to 1 to start or restart the WaitingForPlayers period.

nav_area_bgcolor.help: RGBA color to draw as the background color for nav areas while editing.

nav_create_area_at_feet.help: Anchor nav_begin_area Z to editing player\'s feet

nav_drag_selection_volume_zmax_offset.help: The offset of the nav drag volume top from center

nav_drag_selection_volume_zmin_offset.help: The offset of the nav drag volume bottom from center

nav_draw_limit.help: The maximum number of areas to draw in edit mode

nav_generate_fencetops.help: Autogenerate nav areas on fence and obstacle tops

nav_generate_fixup_jump_areas.help: Convert obsolete jump areas into 2-way connections

nav_generate_incremental_tolerance.help: Z tolerance for adding new nav areas.

nav_max_view_distance.help: Maximum range for precomputed nav mesh visibility (0 = default 1500 units)

nav_quicksave.help: Set to one to skip the time consuming phases of the analysis.  Useful for data collection and testing.

nav_selected_set_border_color.help: Color used to draw the selected set borders while editing.

nav_selected_set_color.help: Color used to draw the selected set background while editing.

nav_show_approach_points.help: Show Approach Points in the Navigation Mesh.

nav_show_area_info.help: Duration in seconds to show nav area ID and attributes while editing

nav_show_player_counts.help: Show current player counts in each area.

nav_show_potentially_visible.help: Show areas that are potentially visible from the current nav area

nav_slope_tolerance.help: The ground unit normal\'s Z component must be this close to the nav area\'s Z component to be generated.

nav_snap_to_grid.help: Snap to the nav generation grid when creating new nav areas

nav_solid_props.help: Make props solid to nav generation/editing

nav_split_place_on_ground.help: If true, nav areas will be placed flush with the ground when split.

nav_update_visibility_on_edit.help: If nonzero editing the mesh will incrementally recompue visibility

nextlevel.help: If set to a valid map name, will change to this map during the next changelevel

nextmap_print_enabled.help: When enabled prints next map to clients

npc_go_do_run.help: Set whether should run on NPC go

npc_height_adjust.help: Enable test mode for ik height adjustment

If shadow provably stops at this distance, the player may be considered for occlusion test. For longer shadows, we just don\'t do occlusion because we are not likely to find full occlusion when one of the boxes is expanded too much.

panel_test_title_safe.help: Test vgui panel positioning with title safe indentation

particle_test_file.help: Name of the particle system to dynamically spawn

phys_penetration_error_time.help: Controls the duration of vphysics penetration error boxes.

player_debug_print_damage.help: When true, print amount and type of all damage received by player to console.

props_break_max_pieces.help: Maximum prop breakable piece count (-1 = model default)

props_break_max_pieces_perframe.help: Maximum prop breakable piece count per frame (-1 = model default)

pvs_min_player_distance.help: Min distance to player at which PVS is used. At closer distances, PVS assumes we can see a shadow or something else from the player, so it\'s safer to just always be \"Visible\"

rr_debug_qa.help: Set to 1 to see debug related to the Question & Answer system used to create conversations between allied NPCs.

rr_debugresponseconcept.help: If set, rr_debugresponses will print only responses testing for the specified concept

rr_debugresponses.help: Show verbose matching output (1 for simple, 2 for rule scoring, 3 for noisy). If set to 4, it will only show response success/failure for npc_selected NPCs.

rr_debugrule.help: If set to the name of the rule, that rule\'s score will be shown whenever a concept is passed into the response rules system.

rr_dumpresponses.help: Dump all response_rules.txt and rules (requires restart)

rr_followup_maxdist.help: \'then ANY\' or \'then ALL\' response followups will be dispatched only to characters within this distance.

rr_remarkable_max_distance.help: AIs will not even consider remarkarbles that are more than this many units away.

rr_remarkable_world_entities_replay_limi.help: TLK_REMARKs will be dispatched no more than this many times for any given info_remarkable

rr_remarkables_enabled.help: If 1, polling for info_remarkables and issuances of TLK_REMARK is enabled.

rr_thenany_score_slop.help: When computing respondents for a \'THEN ANY\' rule, all rule-matching scores within this much of the best score will be considered.

scene_clamplookat.help: Clamp head turns to a MAX of 20 degrees per think.

scene_clientplayback.help: Play all vcds on the clients.

scene_forcecombined.help: When playing back, force use of combined .wav files even in english.

scene_maxcaptionradius.help: Only show closed captions if recipient is within this many units of speaking actor (0==disabled).

scene_showfaceto.help: When playing back, show the directions of faceto events.

scene_showlook.help: When playing back, show the directions of look events.

scene_showunlock.help: Show when a vcd is playing but normal AI is running.

sk_ally_regen_time.help: Time taken for an ally to regenerate a point of health.

smoothstairs.help: Smooth player eye z coordinate when traversing stairs.

snd_prevent_ss_duplicates.help: switch to en/disable the prevention of splitscreen audio file duplicates\n

soundpatch_captionlength.help: How long looping soundpatch captions should display for.

spec_freeze_time.help: Time spend frozen in observer freeze cam.

spec_freeze_traveltime.help: Time taken to zoom in to frame a target in observer freeze cam.

spec_replay_bot.help: Enable Spectator Hltv Replay when killed by bot

spec_replay_winddown_time.help: The trailing time, in seconds, of replay past the event, including fade-out

sv_allchat.help: Players can receive all other players\' text chat, team restrictions apply

sv_autosave.help: Set to 1 to autosave game on level transition. Does not affect autosave triggers.

sv_backspeed.help: How much to slow down backwards motion

sv_benchmark_numticks.help: If > 0, then it only runs the benchmark for this # of ticks.

sv_bonus_challenge.help: Set to values other than 0 to select a bonus map challenge type.

sv_bounce.help: Bounce multiplier for when physically simulated objects collide with other objects.

sv_clamp_unsafe_velocities.help: Whether the server will attempt to clamp velocities that could cause physics bugs or crashes.

sv_comp_mode_allow_dc.help: Set this to 1 to allow direct connects in Competitive mode

sv_dc_friends_reqd.help: Set this to 0 to allow direct connects to a game in progress even if no presents are present

sv_grenade_trajectory_thickness.help: Visible thickness of grenade trajectory arc

sv_grenade_trajectory_time.help: Length of time grenade trajectory remains visible.

sv_grenade_trajectory_time_spectator.help: Length of time grenade trajectory remains visible as a spectator.

sv_lagcompensationforcerestore.help: Don\'t test validity of a lag comp restore, just do it.

sv_lagflushbonecache.help: Flushes entity bone cache on lag compensation

sv_lagpushticks.help: Push computed lag compensation amount by this many ticks.

sv_max_distance_transmit_footsteps.help: Maximum distance to transmit footstep sound effects.

sv_playerperfhistorycount.help: Number of samples to maintain in player perf history

sv_pushaway_force.help: How hard physics objects are pushed away from the players on the server.

sv_pushaway_max_force.help: Maximum amount of force applied to physics objects by players.

sv_pushaway_max_player_force.help: Maximum of how hard the player is pushed away from physics objects.

sv_regeneration_force_on.help: Cheat to test regenerative health systems

sv_showanimstate_activities.help: Show activities in the (server) animation state display.

sv_showladders.help: Show bbox and dismount points for all ladders (must be set before level load.)\n

sv_showlagcompensation.help: Show lag compensated hitboxes whenever a player is lag compensated.

sv_skyname.help: Current name of the skybox texture

sv_soundemitter_trace.help: Show all EmitSound calls including their symbolic name and the actual wave file they resolved to. (-1 = for nobody, 0 = for everybody, n = for one entity)\n

sv_soundemitter_version.help: specfies what version of soundemitter system to use\n

sv_stopspeed.help: Minimum stopping speed when on ground.

sv_strict_notarget.help: If set, notarget will cause entities to never think they are in the pvs

sv_test_scripted_sequences.help: Tests for scripted sequences that are embedded in the world. Run through your map with this set to check for NPCs falling through the world.

sv_thinktimecheck.help: Check for thinktimes all on same timestamp.

sv_unlag_fixstuck.help: Disallow backtracking a player for lag compensation if it will cause them to become stuck

sv_vote_command_delay.help: How long after a vote passes until the action happens

sv_vote_count_spectator_votes.help: Allow spectators to vote on issues?

sv_vote_creation_timer.help: How often someone can individually call a vote.

sv_vote_disallow_kick_on_match_point.help: Disallow vote kicking on the match point round.

sv_vote_failure_timer.help: A vote that fails cannot be re-submitted for this long

sv_vote_quorum_ratio.help: The minimum ratio of players needed to vote on an issue to resolve it.

sv_vote_timer_duration.help: How long to allow voting on an issue

sv_waterdist.help: Vertical view fixup when eyes are near water plane.

tf_escort_score_rate.help: Score for escorting the train, in points per second

think_limit.help: Maximum think time in milliseconds, warning is printed if this is exceeded.

tv_allow_autorecording_index.help: When >=0 restricts autorecording only to the specified TV index

tv_allow_static_shots.help: Auto director uses fixed level cameras for shots

tv_delaymapchange.help: Delays map change until broadcast is complete

view_punch_decay.help: Decay factor exponent for view punch

view_recoil_tracking.help: How closely the view tracks with the aim punch from weapon recoil

vs_challenge_timeout.help: How long a challenge will last for.

vs_duel_cooldown_time.help: Duel cooldown delay (in seconds) after the winner has been decided

vs_duel_intermission.help: Intermission delay (in seconds) before starting another round of duels.

vs_duel_intermission_time.help: Duel intermission delay (in seconds) after the round winner has been decided

vs_duel_no_replay.help: Disables the replay at the conclusion of a duel.

vs_duel_no_slowdown.help: Disables the slowdown at the conclusion of a duel.

vs_duel_override_pvp.help: Override PvP mode, affects all *EMPTY* duels. -1 = no override, 0 = 1on1, 1 = 2on1, 2 = 2on2.

vs_duel_replay_time.help: How long duel replays should play for

vs_duel_rounds.help: Amount of rounds each duel lasts, must be odd.

vs_duel_teamattack_enabled.help: Can players in the same team damage each other?

vs_duel_timelimit.help: Duel time limit (in seconds) in arena mode.

vs_duel_warmup_time_ffa.help: Duel warmup delay (in seconds) for FFA

vs_duel_warmup_time_initial.help: Duel warmup delay (in seconds) while players are frozen

vs_duel_warmup_time_intermediate.help: Duel warmup delay (in seconds) while players are frozen

vs_free_corpsetime.help: How long a player watches their corpse after dying.

vs_free_duel_timelimit.help: How long a private duel can last for.

vs_free_respawntime.help: How long a player needs to wait before respawning.

vs_lms_duel_timelimit.help: Duel time limit (in seconds) in last man standing mode.

vs_lms_intermission.help: Intermission delay (in seconds) before starting another round.

vs_queue_mode.help: Game queue mode, 0 = arena queues, 1 = Tournament mode.

vs_tourney_duel_timelimit.help: Duel time limit (in seconds) in tournament mode.
